sections.title: SYNOPTIC SETUP
sections.text: POTENT AZ/NW MEXICO UPR TROUGH EXPECTED TO FURTHER AMPLIFY AS IT CONTINUES ESE THIS PERIOD...EVOLVING INTO A DEEP CLOSED LOW EXPECTED TO BE CENTERED S OF EL PASO BY 12Z SUN. MEANWHILE...STRONG RIDGE ANCHORED OFF THE S ATLANTIC CST WILL MAINTAIN DEEP SLY FLOW OF ANOMALOUSLY WARM/MOIST AIR ACROSS THE S CNTRL U.S. SFC LOW ATTENDANT TO AZ/MEXICO UPR SYSTEM SHOULD TRACK GENERALLY ESE ACROSS NRN CHIHUAHUA/SW TX LATER TODAY/EARLY TNGT...BEFORE RE-CURVING NE ACROSS S CNTRL TX EARLY SUN. PACIFIC COLD FRONT TRAILING S FROM THE LOW SHOULD CLEAR THE I-35 CORRIDOR IN S TX BY 12Z SUN...WHILE WAVY WARM FRONT NOW EXTENDING FROM NE TX INTO THE LWR TN VLY REDEVELOPS NW INTO THE OZARKS AND LWR OH VLY TODAY/TNGT. THE WRN PART OF THIS BOUNDARY WILL BE UNDERCUT BY ARCTIC FRONT SURGING S ACROSS WRN PORTIONS OF THE PLNS BEGINNING EARLY TNGT.

sections.title: SRN PLNS INTO OZARKS TODAY THROUGH EARLY SUN
sections.text: MORNING SFC AND UPR AIR DATA SHOW LOW TO MID-LVL SLY FLOW CONTINUING TO STRENGTHEN OVER ERN PORTIONS OF THE SRN PLNS AND LA/AR...DOWNSTREAM FROM APPROACHING/AMPLIFYING UPR TROUGH. AS THE TROUGH CONTINUES ESEWD...850 MB SLY WINDS ARE EXPECTED TO INCREASE TO ABOVE 50 KTS FROM CNTRL AND E TX INTO SE OK AND WRN AR. ANOMALOUSLY WARM AND MOIST AIR /PW AOA 1.75 INCHES/ WILL THEREFORE BE IN PLACE SE OF AFOREMENTIONED WARM FRONT FROM ERN OK SWD INTO THE ERN HALF OF TX. THE STRONGEST FORCING FOR ASCENT WITH UPR TROUGH WILL REMAIN WELL WEST OF THE FRONT TODAY. WEAK HEIGHT FALLS WILL...HOWEVER...OVERSPREAD THE BOUNDARY AND WARM SECTOR...IN ASSOCIATION WITH THE GENERAL AMPLIFICATION/EWD MOVEMENT OF THE TROUGH. COUPLED WITH MODEST SFC HEATING AND SUSTAINED LOW-LVL CONFLUENCE...EXPECT THAT THE MOSTLY SHALLOW CONVECTION NOW DEVELOPING IN THE WARM SECTOR WILL GRADUALLY INTENSIFY TODAY...LEADING TO SCTD SFC OR NEAR-SFC-BASED TSTMS FROM CNTRL AND NE TX INTO PARTS OF OK/AR....POSSIBLY AS EARLY AS MIDDAY. GIVEN STRENGTH OF CLOUD-LAYER SHEAR /25+ KT NEAR-SFC SSELY FLOW VEERING TO 60+ KT SSW FLOW AT 700 MB/...QUALITY OF MOISTURE /SFC DEWPOINTS AROUND 70 F/...AND THE LIKELIHOOD FOR UPDRAFTS TO MOVE PARALL

sections.title: MID MS/LWR OH VLYS TODAY THROUGH EARLY SUN
sections.text: A FEW STRONG STORMS MAY OCCUR THROUGH THE PERIOD ALONG WARM FRONT AS IT REDEVELOPS NW INTO REGION. MODEST LOW TO MID-LVL LAPSE RATES...ABSENCE OF STRONG LARGE-SCALE FORCING FOR ASCENT...AND UPDRAFT COMPETITION EXPECTED LIMIT STRENGTH OF INDIVIDUAL STORMS...DESPITE PRESENCE OF SUBSTANTIAL CLOUD-LAYER FLOW. ..CORFIDI/COHEN.. 12/26/2015

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: MID AND UPPER-LEVEL WIND MAXIMA FROM SRN CA INTO BAJA AND THE GULF OF CA WILL DEVELOP SEWD INTO NWRN MEXICO...CONTRIBUTING TO THE OVERALL DEEPENING OF THE PARENT CLOSED LOW AS IT TRACKS FROM SRN AZ TO FAR WRN TX AND CHIHUAHUA MEXICO BY 12Z/SUNDAY. THIS PATTERN EVOLUTION WILL RESULT IN A CORRIDOR OF MID-LEVEL HEIGHT FALLS/DCVA SPREADING EWD ACROSS NWRN MEXICO INTO SWRN TX THIS PERIOD. AT THE SURFACE...AN AREA OF LOW PRESSURE DEEPENING OVER CHIHUAHUA MEXICO WILL DEVELOP GENERALLY EWD ALONG A SWD-SURGING COLD FRONT INTO THE TX BIG BEND BY THIS EVENING BEFORE REACHING THE TX HILL COUNTRY BY THE END OF THE FORECAST PERIOD.

sections.title: SRN PLAINS INTO OZARK PLATEAU THIS AFTERNOON THROUGH TONIGHT
sections.text: 12Z RAOB DATA INDICATE THE PRESENCE OF A VERY MOIST AIR MASS IN PLACE ACROSS THE PRE-FRONTAL WARM SECTOR WITH LOWEST-100-MB MEAN-MIXING RATIOS OF 13-16 G/KG BENEATH MODESTLY STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES OF AROUND 7 C/KM. AND WHILE WIDESPREAD CLOUDS WILL LIMIT THE DEGREE OF BOUNDARY-LAYER WARMING...THE RICH LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE WILL CONTRIBUTE TO AFTERNOON MLCAPE VALUES OF 1000-1500 J/KG. TSTMS /MAINLY ELEVATED/ ARE RAPIDLY DEVELOPING THIS MORNING ACROSS WRN NORTH TX AND OK WITHIN A ZONE OF STRONG WAA AND ISENTROPIC ASCENT ALONG A 40-50 KT LLJ...IMMEDIATELY TO THE NORTH OF A SURFACE FRONT STRETCHING FROM A WEAK LOW NEAR FST NEWD TO NEAR SPS AND THEN EWD TO N OF TXK. SOME OF THESE ELEVATED STORMS MAY CONTAIN MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL. THE STRONG LOW-LEVEL WAA SHOULD ALLOW FOR THE CONTINUED NWD MOVEMENT OF THE AFOREMENTIONED FRONT THROUGH THE RED RIVER VALLEY AND OZARK PLATEAU BEFORE IT IS OVERTAKEN BY A POWERFUL COLD FRONT SURGING SWD THROUGH THE SRN HIGH PLAINS. AS SUCH...THE GREATEST POTENTIAL FOR SURFACE-BASED SUPERCELLS --AND ATTENDANT TORNADO THREAT-- WILL EXIST WITHIN THIS WAA REGIME --AHEAD OF THE COLD FRONT-- THIS AFTERNOON INTO EVENING FROM PORTIONS OF CNTRL TX INTO SERN OK AND WR

sections.title: MID SOUTH INTO OH VALLEY
sections.text: MULTIPLE CLUSTERS OF TSTMS ARE ONGOING FROM THE MID SOUTH INTO THE OH VALLEY ALONG AND TO THE NORTH OF A WARM FRONT LIFTING NWD INTO THE LOWER-OH VALLEY. WIDESPREAD CLOUDS AND POOR LAPSE RATES WILL LIMIT THE DEGREE OF AIR MASS DESTABILIZATION WITH THE MAJORITY OF TSTMS LIKELY REMAINING SLIGHTLY ELEVATED TO THE NORTH OF THE POLEWARD-MOVING WARM SECTOR. NONETHELESS...THE PRESENCE OF RELATIVELY STRONG VERTICAL SHEAR INVOF THE SURFACE FRONT SUGGESTS THAT A LOW-PROBABILITY RISK FOR SEVERE WEATHER WILL EXIST WITH ANY STORMS THAT CAN BECOME SURFACE-BASED OR NEAR-SURFACE-BASED. FOR ADDITIONAL NEAR-TERM GUIDANCE...SEE MCD 2064. ..MEAD/BUNTING.. 12/26/2015

sections.title: TX
sections.text: A WWD EXPANSION HAS BEEN MADE TO THE 10 PERCENT TORNADO PROBABILITY AREA...AND A 30 PERCENT WIND PROBABILITY HAS BEEN ADDED ACROSS PARTS OF CENTRAL AND SRN TX WITH THIS UPDATE. TORNADO PROBABILITY CHANGES WERE DONE TO ACCOUNT FOR CURRENT TORNADO WATCH AND PROSPECTS FOR AT LEAST A COUPLE OF TORNADOES THROUGH THIS EVENING ACROSS PORTIONS OF N-CNTRL TX NWD ACROSS THE RED RIVER INTO SERN OK. WEAK BACKGROUND ASCENT WILL CONTINUE TO ACT ON A WARM AND ANOMALOUSLY MOIST AIRMASS ACROSS TX AND SOUTHEAST OK TO SUPPORT CONTINUED ISOLATED TO SCATTERED WARM SECTOR CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT. MEANWHILE...MORE WIDESPREAD DEEP CONVECTION WILL BE SUSTAINED BY SLAB ASCENT ON THE COOL SIDE OF A PRONOUNCED COLD FRONT SETTLING GRADUALLY SOUTH-SOUTHEAST ACROSS NWRN TX. WARM SECTOR CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT IS FORECAST TO REMAIN RELATIVELY SPARSE IN COVERAGE THROUGH THIS EVENING. HOWEVER...ANY STORMS THAT CAN DEVELOP WITHIN AN AREA BOUNDED BY TX HILL COUNTRY NORTH ACROSS THE RED RIVER INTO SERN OK...WILL EXIST IN A SUPPORTIVE REGIME FOR TORNADOES...HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. DESPITE GENERALLY WEAK ASCENT ACROSS THE WARM SECTOR....POCKETS OF STRONGER SFC HEATING MAY AID STORM INITIATION WHERE EFFECTIVE SRH IS ON TH

sections.title: SRN PLAINS/OZARKS
sections.text: AN UPPER-LEVEL LOW WILL MOVE INTO THE RIO GRANDE RIVER VALLEY TONIGHT AS A COLD FRONT ADVANCES SEWD ACROSS CNTRL AND NORTH TX INTO SE OK. AHEAD OF THE FRONT...A MOIST AIRMASS IS IN PLACE AND SFC DEWPOINTS ARE IN THE UPPER 60S TO NEAR 70 F CONTRIBUTING TO MODERATE INSTABILITY ACROSS MUCH OF THE WARM SECTOR. LATEST RADAR TRENDS SHOW A LINE OF THUNDERSTORMS DEVELOPING ALONG THE FRONT WITH DISCRETE CELLS LOCATED NEAR THE DALLAS/FORT WORTH METRO. THIS ACTIVITY SHOULD HAVE A THREAT FOR TORNADOES...HAIL AND WIND DAMAGE FOR A COUPLE MORE HOURS BUT THESE THREATS SHOULD GRADUALLY DIMINISH THIS EVENING. FURTHER TO THE SOUTH IN THE TX HILL COUNTRY...MESOSCALE ANALYSIS IS SHOWING A POCKET OF MODERATE TO STRONG INSTABILITY WITH MLCAPE ESTIMATED IN THE 2000 TO 2500 J/KG RANGE. MODEL FORECASTS SUGGEST THAT THUNDERSTORMS WILL DEVELOP ACROSS WCNTRL TX AS A BAND OF LARGE-SCALE ASCENT MOVES EWD INTO REGION LATE THIS EVENING. THIS CONVECTION IS FORECAST TO DEVELOP INTO A SQUALL-LINE AND MOVE EWD ACROSS THE WRN TX HILL COUNTRY. FORECAST SOUNDINGS TO THE WEST OF SAN ANTONIO AT 06Z SHOW 50 KT OF 0-6 KM SHEAR WITH SOME DIRECTIONAL SHEAR BELOW 850 MB AND STRONG SPEED SHEAR IN THE LOWEST 2 KM AGL. THIS SHOUL

mesoscale_discussions.summary: LOCALLY STRONG WIND GUSTS AND/OR A TORNADO CANNOT BE RULED OUT ACROSS NORTHWEST AND NORTHERN-MIDDLE TN INTO ADJACENT PARTS OF SOUTHWEST KY THIS MORNING. GIVEN THE POTENTIAL FOR LOW COVERAGE OF STRONG OR SEVERE STORMS ACROSS THE DISCUSSION AREA...AN WATCH IS NOT WARRANTED AT THIS TIME. HOWEVER...CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED FOR THIS REGION.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 1435Z...MOSAIC AND MEMPHIS WSR-88D IMAGERY INDICATED A SMALL BOWING LINE OF STORMS LOCATED IN EXTREME NORTHEAST AR AND THE ADJACENT PORTION OF THE SOUTHEAST MO BOOTHEEL...WITH THE LINE MOVING TO THE EAST-NORTHEAST AT 35-40 KT. SURFACE STREAMLINE ANALYSES AND OBSERVATIONS SHOWED A WARM FRONT ADVANCING TO THE NORTH ACROSS WESTERN TN THIS MORNING...WITH THE BOWING LINE OF STORMS APPEARING TO BE NEAR OR JUST SOUTH OF THE FRONT. THESE OBSERVATIONS COMBINED WITH 40-50-KT SSWLY LOW-LEVEL WINDS JUST OFF THE SURFACE PER THE MEMPHIS VWP DATA SUGGEST A THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS WITH THIS BAND OF STORMS. IN ADDITION...THE SAME VWP DATA INDICATED STRONG SURFACE-1 KM SHEAR OF 35 KT AND 0-1 KM SRH AROUND 365 M2/S2. THIS SHEAR AND THE LEWP STRUCTURE IN THE BOWING LINE WITH THE POTENTIAL FOR THIS ACTIVITY TO BE SURFACE BASED...A TORNADO THREAT CANNOT BE RULED OUT AS THE STORMS MOVE THROUGH NORTHWEST TN TO FAR SOUTHWEST KY THIS MORNING. FORECAST HEIGHT RISES ACROSS THIS REGION THROUGH EARLY AFTERNOON AND APPARENT LACK OF LARGER SCALE FORCING ARE A NEGATIVE FACTOR FOR AN INCREASE IN STORM COVERAGE. HOWEVER...RECENT RAP AND 00Z ECMWF/06Z NAM SUGGEST A WEAK IMPULSE MAY BE TRACKING TO THE NORTHEAST ACROSS THE DISCUSSION AREA THIS MORNING AND CONTRIBUTING TO SOME UPWARD VERTICAL MOTION. THIS LOCALIZED FORCING MAY ALLOW THE ONGOING STORMS TO PERSIST WITH SOME SEVERE THREAT SPREADING ACROSS NORTHWEST TN INTO SOUTHWEST KY. HOWEVER...THIS LOCALIZED FORCING MAY SUPPORT AN ISOLATED SEVERE THREAT SPREADING ACROSS NORTHWEST TN INTO SOUTHWEST KY THIS MORNING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED SEVERE STORMS WITH LARGE HAIL ARE LIKELY THROUGH THIS AFTERNOON. TRENDS ARE BEING MONITORED AND A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH IS POSSIBLE BY EARLY AFTERNOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THUNDERSTORMS HAVE RECENTLY INCREASED IN COVERAGE AND INTENSITY ACROSS NWRN TEXAS/SWRN OK WITH A REPORT OF 1.25 INCH HAIL IN CADDO COUNTY. THESE STORMS WERE DEVELOPING ON THE IMMEDIATE COOL SIDE OF A COLD FRONT EXTENDING FROM NERN THROUGH SWRN OK AND INTO W TX. AS THE UPPER-LEVEL FLOW CONTINUES TO BACK/STRENGTHEN THIS AFTN IN ADVANCE OF THE POWERFUL UPPER-LEVEL TROUGH...THE COLD FRONT WILL BECOME INCREASINGLY ANAFRONTAL IN NATURE AS TSTMS CONTINUE TO DEVELOP WITH ELEVATED INFLOW PARCELS ABOVE THE STABLE BOUNDARY LAYER. EFFECTIVE SHEAR VALUES IN EXCESS OF 40 KTS WILL BE FAVORABLE FOR MID-LEVEL UPDRAFT ROTATION...AND COMBINED WITH MUCAPE OF 500 TO LOCALLY 1000 J/KG WILL RESULT IN A CONTINUED RISK FOR LARGE HAIL WITH THE STRONGEST STORMS. SOME UNCERTAINTY EXISTS REGARDING THE COVERAGE OF THE SEVERE THREAT THROUGH THIS AFTN...BUT CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED AND A SVR TSTM WATCH MAY BE NEEDED BY EARLY AFTN.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TORNADO WATCH ISSUANCE IS LIKELY ACROSS PARTS OF NORTH TX AND SOUTH TO SOUTHEAST OK INTO WESTERN AR. CONCERN IS INCREASING FOR SEVERE WEATHER TO DEVELOP ACROSS THIS REGION THIS AFTERNOON WITH ALL SEVERE HAZARDS POSSIBLE INCLUDING A FEW TORNADOES.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TRENDS IN MESONET OBSERVATIONS SHOWED A COLD FRONT HAS ADVANCED THROUGH MUCH OF THE WESTERN THIRD OF OK...THE WESTERN HALF OF THE TX BIG COUNTRY TO SOUTHWEST TX. CURRENTLY...THE NORTHERN EXTENT FOR SURFACE-BASED STORMS IS LIKELY IN VICINITY OF A WARM FRONT THAT EXTENDS FROM JUST SOUTH OF THE OKC METRO /SOUTHERN MCCLAIN AND CLEVELAND COUNTIES/ EAST INTO WEST CENTRAL AR...WITH SURFACE DEW POINTS IN THE UPPER 60S TO AROUND 70 F SOUTH OF THIS BOUNDARY. THE WARM SECTOR ENVIRONMENT ACROSS CENTRAL AND NORTH TX INTO PORTIONS OF SOUTHERN AND EASTERN OK AND WESTERN AR IS ALREADY CONDUCIVE TO SUPPORT STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS. THE SPECIAL 18Z FWD SOUNDING SAMPLED THIS ENVIRONMENT VERY WELL /MODERATE INSTABILITY /MLCAPE EXCEEDING 1500 J PER KG/...EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR EXCEEDING 50 KT...AND SFC-3 KM SRH EXCEEDING 300 M2 PER S2/...SUPPORTING THE LIKELIHOOD FOR ORGANIZED ROTATING STORMS. ALTHOUGH STRONGER DEEP-LAYER FORCING FOR ASCENT WILL TEND TO REMAIN WEST OF THE WARM SECTOR THIS AFTERNOON...EVEN WEAK UPWARD VERTICAL MOTION WITHIN THIS ANOMALOUSLY MOIST AND FAVORABLY SHEARED ENVIRONMENT POSES CONCERN FOR A TORNADO THREAT. STORMS THAT FORM NEAR OR ALONG THE COLD FRONT SHOULD QUICKLY BECOME UNDERCUT BY THIS BOUNDARY AND TEND TO POSE A THREAT FOR PRIMARILY HAIL. REFER TO MCD 2065 FOR THIS ELEVATED HAIL THREAT. THE TORNADO THREAT WILL BE ATTENDANT TO NEW UPDRAFTS/STORM DEVELOPMENT FARTHER EAST ACROSS THE WARM SECTOR IN NORTH-CENTRAL TX TO SOUTHEAST OK AND WESTERN AR. ACTIVITY IN THIS REGIME WILL TEND TO TRACK PARALLEL TO AXES OF LOW-LEVEL CONFLUENCE AHEAD OF THE COLD FRONT...RESULTING IN A LONGER GESTATION PERIOD OF THE STRONGER INSTABILITY AND STRONGLY SHEARED ENVIRONMENT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS DEVELOPING ACROSS PART OF THE TX HILL COUNTRY AND SOUTH CENTRAL TX COULD POSE A THREAT FOR A TORNADO PRIOR TO MOVING NORTH INTO TORNADO WATCH 569. LIMITED AREAL COVERAGE OF THIS THREAT CURRENTLY PRECLUDES THE ISSUANCE OF A NEW WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MOSAIC RADAR IMAGERY INDICATED SEVERAL SOUTH-NORTH ORIENTED BANDS OF CONVECTION/CONFLUENCE ZONES LOCATED ACROSS THE TX HILL COUNTRY INTO PART OF SOUTH CENTRAL TX. THESE UPDRAFTS ARE TENDING TO INCREASE IN INTENSITY/DEEPEN AS THEY TRACK NORTHWARD ACROSS 1-2 ROWS OF COUNTIES LOCATED IMMEDIATELY SOUTH OF TORNADO WATCH 569. THE AIR MASS ACROSS THIS DISCUSSION AREA HAS BECOME MODERATELY UNSTABLE AND STRONGLY SHEARED IN THE LOW-LEVELS AND THROUGH A DEEP-LAYER...SUPPORTIVE OF SUPERCELLS AND A TORNADO THREAT. THE PRIMARY LIMITING FACTOR THUS FAR AND LIKELY INTO THE EVENING IS THE STRENGTH OF THE CAP WITH SOUTHWARD EXTENT FROM WW 569. THIS CAP WAS EVIDENT IN THE 12Z SOUNDINGS IN SOUTH TX /DRT...CRP AND BRO/...AND SIMILAR CAPPING REMAINS EVIDENT IN THE LATEST RAP SOUNDINGS. HOWEVER...TRENDS IN RADAR IMAGERY SUGGEST THE CAP MAY BE SUFFICIENTLY WEAK ENOUGH TO ALLOW FOR A TORNADO THREAT JUST SOUTH OF WW 569. IF THE AREAL EXTENT OF THIS THREAT SHOWS SIGNS OF INCREASING...THEN A NEW TORNADO WATCH MAY BE NEEDED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE THREAT FOR ADDITIONAL TORNADOES CONTINUES ACROSS MUCH OF WW 569 LATE THIS AFTERNOON INTO THE EARLY EVENING. MEANWHILE... THE COLD FRONT HAS BEGUN TO MOVE INTO THE FAR WESTERN PART OF THE TORNADO WATCH UNDERCUTTING THE STORMS FROM JEFFERSON COUNTY OK TO STEPHENS COUNTY TX. HAIL WILL BECOME THE PRIMARY THREAT WITH STORMS AS THEY ARE UNDERCUT BY THE EAST-SOUTHEASTWARD-ADVANCING COLD FRONT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: HEIGHT FALLS INTO THE EARLY EVENING AHEAD OF THE DEEPENING SOUTHWEST STATES/NORTHERN MEXICO UPPER TROUGH WILL PROVIDE SUFFICIENT UPWARD VERTICAL MOTION FOR ADDITIONAL STORMS DEVELOPING ACROSS THE WARM SECTOR. THE 20Z SURFACE ANALYSIS INDICATED THE COLD FRONT HAS CONTINUED ADVANCING TO THE EAST/SOUTHEAST THIS AFTERNOON AND EXTENDED FROM NORTHEAST OK TO EAST AND SOUTH OF THE OKC METRO THROUGH GARVIN TO JEFFERSON COUNTIES OK...AND THROUGH MUCH OF WESTERN NORTH TX COUNTIES. MEANWHILE...THE WARM SECTOR REMAINS QUITE MOIST AND MODERATELY UNSTABLE WITH SOME BREAKS IN THE CLOUDS HAVING FURTHER ENHANCED THE DEGREE OF INSTABILITY. THIS DESTABILIZATION HAS EXPAND EAST ACROSS MORE OF EAST TX TOWARD THE ARKLATEX...RESULTING IN SOME EASTWARD EXPANSION OF WW 569 IN NORTHEAST TX. TRENDS IN THE VWP DATA FROM CENTRAL TX TO EASTERN OK SHOWED STRENGTHENING SOUTHERLY WINDS OF 50-KT ATOP SOUTH-SOUTHEAST SURFACE WINDS...MAINTAINING STRONG LOW-LEVEL SHEAR FOR A CONTINUED TORNADO THREAT. ..PETERS.. 12/26/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A TORNADO THREAT WILL CONTINUE THROUGH THE EARLY EVENING HOURS PARTICULARLY ACROSS NORTH-CENTRAL TX /INCLUDING NEAR THE DFW METRO AREA/ INTO EAST-CENTRAL/FAR SOUTH-CENTRAL OK. TORNADO WATCH 569 CONTINUES UNTIL 02Z/8PM CST.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RELATED TO A PERSISTENT CORRIDOR OF MOIST/CONFLUENCE LOW-LEVEL FLOW AHEAD OF A SOUTHEASTWARD-ADVANCING COLD FRONT...THE PRIMARY TORNADO THREAT WILL CONTINUE THROUGH EARLY EVENING /THROUGH 7PM-8PM CST/ ESPECIALLY IN AREAS NEAR/EAST OF I-35 ACROSS NORTH-CENTRAL TX...AND TO A LESSER EXTENT INTO SOUTHERN/EASTERN OK AS FAR NORTH-NORTHEAST AS THE I-40 VICINITY. SIMILAR TO THE RECENT 00Z DFW OBSERVED SOUNDING...THE FORT WORTH 88D VWP CONTINUES TO SAMPLE VERY STRONG/LARGELY UNIDIRECTIONAL SOUTH-SOUTHWESTERLY WINDS ATOP SOUTH-SOUTHEASTERLY NEAR-SURFACE-WINDS...WITH 0-1 KM SRH ESTIMATED TO BE AROUND 200-250 M2/S2. WITHIN A MOIST ENVIRONMENT...THIS SCENARIO WILL CONTINUE THE POTENTIAL FOR SCATTERED SUPERCELLS THROUGH THE EARLY EVENING WITH AT LEAST TRANSIENT/MODERATE LOW-LEVEL ROTATION AND THE RELATED RISK FOR AN ADDITIONAL TORNADO OR TWO. WITH ANY TORNADO THREAT LIKELY CURRENTLY AT ITS PEAK AS OF 530 PM CST...CURRENT THINKING IS THE DISCRETE SUPERCELL-RELATED TORNADO RISK SHOULD GRADUALLY DIMINISH WITH INCREASINGLY EFFECTIVE-FRONT-DOMINANT CONVECTION INTO MID/LATE EVENING. ..GUYER.. 12/26/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED TORNADO POTENTIAL WILL CONTINUE MAINLY THROUGH MID-EVENING ACROSS NORTH TX. TORNADO WATCH 569 IS CURRENTLY SCHEDULED TO EXPIRE...BUT A TEMPORAL WATCH EXTENSION /LIKELY FOR 2-HR/ WILL BE NEEDED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SEMI-DISCRETE SUPERCELLS WITH A TORNADO HISTORY CONTINUE ACROSS THE EASTERN PART OF THE DFW METRO AREA AS OF 715 PM CST. THESE STORMS ARE OCCURRING JUST AHEAD OF A SOUTHEASTWARD-MOVING COLD FRONT. A SLIGHTLY COOLING BOUNDARY LAYER AND THE EVENTUAL UNDERCUTTING NATURE OF THE COLD FRONT IS EXPECTED TO YIELD A GRADUALLY DIMINISHING TORNADO RISK THROUGH MID/LATE EVENING...WITH STRONGER CONVECTION OTHERWISE RELEGATED TO NEAR THE FRONT. EVEN SO...GIVEN THAT SOME TORNADO RISK WILL CONTINUE ESPECIALLY ACROSS NORTH TX...A TEMPORAL WATCH EXTENSION WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED FOR PARTS OF NORTH TX/FAR SOUTHEAST OK AND POSSIBLY OTHER PARTS OF EASTERN OK FOR AN ISOLATED TORNADO/WIND DAMAGE RISK. ..GUYER.. 12/27/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORM RISK IS EXPECTED TO GRADUALLY INCREASE THROUGH LATE EVENING ACROSS MUCH OF SOUTHWEST/WEST-CENTRAL TX. SEVERE HAIL/WIND WILL BE THE PRIMARY HAZARDS. A WATCH MAY EVENTUALLY BECOME NECESSARY FOR PARTS OF THE REGION AS STORMS INCREASE ACROSS THE EDWARDS PLATEAU/LOW ROLLING PLAINS VICINITY THROUGH THE LATE EVENING/OVERNIGHT HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A STRONG COLD FRONT WILL CONTINUE TO PROGRESS SOUTHEASTWARD TONIGHT ACROSS THE EDWARDS PLATEAU VICINITY. RELATED TO INCREASING FORCING FOR ASCENT AHEAD OF THE DIGGING SOUTHERN ROCKIES/NORTHERN MEXICO UPPER TROUGH...NORTH-SOUTH BANDS OF ELEVATED THUNDERSTORMS CONTINUE TO STEADILY INCREASE ACROSS FAR WEST TX WEST OF THE MIDLAND/LUBBOCK AREAS AS OF 8PM CST. MEANWHILE...OTHER STRONG ELEVATED THUNDERSTORMS HAVE INCREASED ACROSS THE TX BIG COUNTRY /ROUGHLY SPANNING ABILENE TO BROWNWOOD/ WITHIN THE POST-FRONTAL ENVIRONMENT. NEAR-SURFACE-BASED STRONG THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT CANNOT BE ENTIRELY RULED OUT NEAR THE SOUTHWARD-MOVING FRONT ACROSS PARTS OF THE SOUTHERN EDWARDS PLATEAU/RIO GRANDE VALLEY VICINITY INTO THE LATE EVENING/OVERNIGHT HOURS. HOWEVER...WITH MUCH OF THE FORCING FOR ASCENT MAXIMIZED NORTH-NORTHWEST OF THE SURFACE COLD FRONT...THE MAJORITY OF STRONG TO POTENTIALLY SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS CAPABLE OF HAIL AND LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE FOCUSED NEAR/NORTH OF THE COLD FRONT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: WHILE THE OVERALL SEVERE/TORNADO POTENTIAL HAS DIMINISHED SINCE EARLIER THIS EVENING...A LOW-END SEVERE RISK MAY NONETHELESS PERSIST INTO THE OVERNIGHT WITHIN A CORRIDOR FROM SOUTHEAST OK/FAR NORTHEAST TX INTO WESTERN/NORTHERN AR.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SOME STRONGER UPDRAFTS/BOWING SEGMENTS WILL PERSIST INTO THE OVERNIGHT ALONG/JUST BEHIND AN EFFECTIVE FRONT THAT EXTENDS SOUTHWEST-NORTHEASTWARD ACROSS SOUTHEAST OK INTO WESTERN AND NORTHWEST/NORTH-CENTRAL AR. WHILE DISCRETE WARM SECTOR STORM DEVELOPMENT IS UNLIKELY...A FEW OF THESE STRONGER STORMS COULD BE NEAR-SURFACE-BASED NEAR/JUST BEHIND THE FRONT. A HIGHLY SHEARED ENVIRONMENT EXISTS INCLUDING UPWARDS OF 250-300 M2/S2 0-1 KM SRH AS PER THE FORT SMITH AR WSR-88D VWP. AS SUCH...A LOWER-END HAIL/DAMAGING WIND AND POSSIBLY A TORNADO RISK CANNOT BE ENTIRELY RULED OUT INTO THE OVERNIGHT...ALTHOUGH THE OVERALL SEVERE POTENTIAL SHOULD BE MITIGATED BY THE ANAFRONTAL NATURE OF THE CONVECTION.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS CAPABLE OF MOSTLY HAIL/DAMAGING WINDS WILL CONTINUE ACROSS THE EDWARDS PLATEAU VICINITY IN/NEAR SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH 570...WHICH CONTINUES UNTIL 10Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: NORTH-SOUTH BANDS OF CONVECTION WILL CONTINUE TO INCREASE/GROW UPSCALE INTO AN EASTWARD-MOVING SQUALL LINE ACROSS PARTS THE EDWARDS PLATEAU/LOW ROLLING PLAINS...WITH THESE STORMS ROUGHLY ALONG A SWEETWATER-SAN ANGELO-SONORA TO WEST OF DEL RIO AXIS AS OF 1145 PM CST. THE VAST MAJORITY OF THIS CONVECTION INCLUDING ITS EMBEDDED NORTHEASTWARD-RACING BOWING SEGMENTS WILL REMAIN ELEVATED TO THE NORTH OF A STRONG COLD FRONT THAT IS LOCATED ACROSS SOUTHERN PARTS OF THE EDWARDS PLATEAU. ACCORDINGLY...SOME HAIL/LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE POSSIBLE. A NEAR-SURFACE-BASED STORM OR TWO...INCLUDING AT LEAST A NON-ZERO TORNADO RISK...COULD OCCUR ALONG THE SOUTHERN PERIPHERY OF THE CONVECTIVE LINE CLOSER TO THE RIO GRANDE VALLEY VICINITY/SOUTHERN EDWARDS PLATEAU. ..GUYER.. 12/27/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS SHOULD GRADUALLY INCREASE IN COVERAGE AND INTENSITY LATER THIS MORNING...WITH A THREAT OF TORNADOES AND DAMAGING WINDS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A VERY MOIST AND HIGHLY-SHEARED AIR MASS IS CURRENTLY IN PLACE AHEAD OF A SLOWING COLD FRONT FROM ERN TX INTO SRN AR AND LA. CURRENTLY...THE MAJORITY OF THE THUNDERSTORM ACTIVITY IS ELEVATED ATOP THE MORE STABLE AIR MASS BEHIND THE FRONT. HOWEVER...OTHER SHOWERS WERE DEEPENING ACROSS THE WARM SECTOR...WITH RECENT LIGHTNING ACTIVITY WEST OF HOUSTON INDICATING DEEPER/MORE VIGOROUS UPDRAFT DEVELOPMENT. EFFECTIVE SRH VALUES OF 300-400 M2/S2 ARE WIDESPREAD ACROSS THIS VERY MOIST AIR MASS...WHICH WILL FAVOR SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF AT LEAST BRIEF TORNADOES. THE GREATEST TORNADO THREAT MAY BE WITH CELLS THAT FORM AHEAD OF THE COLD FRONT IN CONFLUENCE BANDS. LATER IN THE DAY...THE COLD FRONT WILL CATCH UP/CONSOLIDATE WITH THE PRE-FRONTAL BANDS...WITH A MORE FOCUSED N-S ORIENTED LINE OF STORMS. SOME OF THESE CELLS MAY STILL PRODUCE TORNADOES AS FLOW ALOFT WILL BE MERIDIONAL AND FAVOR SOME RESIDENCE TIME ALONG THE BOUNDARY.
